CREATE TRIGGER setup_marks_insert AFTER INSERT ON messages BEGIN
    DELETE FROM setup_marks WHERE thread_id=NEW.thread_id AND message_id=NEW.id;
    INSERT INTO setup_marks(source_row,thread_id,message_id,kind,solid,at,http_status,provider) SELECT m.rowid, m.thread_id, m.id,
    CASE m.kind WHEN 'text' THEN 'reply' ELSE 'refusal' END,
    CASE WHEN m.kind='text' AND trim(COALESCE(m.text,''),char(32,9,10,11,12,13,160))<>'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, m.at,
    CASE WHEN m.kind='activity' THEN json_extract(m.json,'$.tool.providerError.httpStatus') END,
    CASE WHEN m.kind='activity' THEN json_extract(m.json,'$.tool.providerError.provider') END
  FROM messages m WHERE m.rowid=NEW.rowid AND m.kind IN ('text','activity') AND (instr(m.json,'turnTerminal')>0 OR instr(m.json,'providerError')>0) AND CASE WHEN json_valid(m.json) THEN CASE m.kind
      WHEN 'text' THEN m.role='bot' AND json_extract(m.json,'$.turnTerminal')=1
      WHEN 'activity' THEN json_type(m.json,'$.tool.providerError')='object'
    END ELSE 0 END;
  END

    CASE WHEN m.kind='activity' THEN json_extract(m.json,'$.tool.providerError.httpStatus') END,
    CASE WHEN m.kind='activity' THEN json_extract(m.json,'$.tool.providerError.provider') END
  FROM messages m WHERE m.rowid=NEW.rowid AND m.kind IN ('text','activity') AND (instr(m.json,'turnTerminal')>0 OR instr(m.json,'providerError')>0) AND CASE WHEN json_valid(m.json) THEN CASE m.kind

CREATE TRIGGER inbox_raw_added AFTER INSERT ON inbox_raw BEGIN
    UPDATE inbox_keys SET copies=copies+1 WHERE source_key=NEW.source_key;
    INSERT INTO inbox_keys(source_key,copies) SELECT NEW.source_key,1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inbox_keys WHERE source_key=NEW.source_key);
    DELETE FROM inbox_items WHERE source_key=NEW.source_key;
    INSERT INTO inbox_items(source_key,thread_id,message_id,source_row,at,kind,expired,run_id,routine_id,status,summary,title,kind_segment,copies,decision,to_read,segment,owed_or_over,read_version,snoozed_until,cleared_at,live)
    SELECT h.source_key, h.thread_id, h.message_id, h.source_row, h.at, h.kind, h.expired, h.run_id, h.routine_id, h.status, h.summary, h.title, h.kind_segment, k.copies,
      CASE WHEN h.status IN ('pending','waiting','needs-input','needs-you') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
      CASE WHEN h.status IN ('blocked','limit-reached','failed','missed','paused','digest') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
      CASE WHEN h.kind_segment='routine' AND h.status IN ('pending','waiting','needs-input','needs-you') THEN 'question' ELSE h.kind_segment END,
      CASE WHEN h.status IN ('pending','waiting','needs-input','needs-you') OR h.status IN ('blocked','limit-reached','failed','missed','paused','digest') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
      s.read_version, s.snoozed_until, s.cleared_at,
      CASE WHEN s.cleared_at IS NULL OR h.at>s.cleared_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    FROM inbox_raw h JOIN inbox_keys k ON k.source_key=h.source_key LEFT JOIN inbox_item_state s ON s.source_key=h.source_key
    WHERE h.rowid=(SELECT x.rowid FROM inbox_raw x WHERE x.source_key=NEW.source_key ORDER BY x.terminal DESC,x.at DESC,x.source_row DESC LIMIT 1)
      AND NOT(h.status='completed' AND length(trim(h.summary))=0);
  END

objects.name: inbox_item_added
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER inbox_item_added AFTER INSERT ON inbox_items BEGIN
    INSERT INTO inbox_counts(thread_id) SELECT NEW.thread_id WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inbox_counts WHERE thread_id=NEW.thread_id);
    UPDATE inbox_counts SET v_all=v_all+(CASE WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      v_approvals=v_approvals+(CASE WHEN NEW.owed_or_over=1 AND NEW.segment='approval' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      v_decisions=v_decisions+(CASE WHEN NEW.expired=0 AND NEW.decision=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      v_questions=v_questions+(CASE WHEN NEW.owed_or_over=1 AND NEW.segment='question' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      v_connections=v_connections+(CASE WHEN NEW.owed_or_over=1 AND NEW.segment='connection' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      v_routines=v_routines+(CASE WHEN NEW.kind_segment='routine' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      v_to_read=v_to_read+(CASE WHEN NEW.to_read=1 AND (NEW.status<>'digest' OR NEW.read_version IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      v_results=v_results+(CASE WHEN NEW.decision=0 AND NEW.to_read=0 AND NEW.kind IN ('routine.run','goal.run','text') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      l_all=l_all+(CASE WHEN NEW.live=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      l_approvals=l_approvals+(CASE WHEN NEW.owed_or_over=1 AND NEW.segment='approval' AND NEW.live=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      l_decisions=l_decisions+(CASE WHEN NEW.expired=0 AND NEW.decision=1 AND NEW.live=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      l_questions=l_questions+(CASE WHEN NEW.owed_or_over=1 AND NEW.segment='question' AND NEW.live=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      l_connections=l_connections+(CASE WHEN NEW.owed_or_over=1 AND NEW.segment='connection' AND NEW.live=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      l_routines=l_routines+(CASE WHEN NEW.kind_segment='routine' AND NEW.live=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      l_to_read=l_to_read+(CASE WHEN NEW.to_read=1 AND (NEW.status<>'digest' OR NEW.read_version IS NULL) AND NEW.live=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      l_results=l_results+(CASE WHEN NEW.decision=0 AND NEW.to_read=0 AND NEW.kind IN ('routine.run','goal.run','text') AND NEW.live=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      o_approvals=o_approvals+(CASE WHEN NEW.decision=1 AND NEW.segment='approval' AND NEW.live=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      o_questions=o_questions+(CASE WHEN NEW.decision=1 AND NEW.segment='question' AND NEW.live=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      o_connections=o_connections+(CASE WHEN NEW.decision=1 AND NEW.segment='connection' AND NEW.live=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      o_decisions=o_decisions+(CASE WHEN NEW.decision=1 AND NEW.live=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      o_unread=o_unread+(CASE WHEN NEW.to_read=1 AND NEW.read_version IS NULL AND NEW.live=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      owed_open=owed_open+(CASE WHEN NEW.decision=1 AND NEW.expired=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) WHERE thread_id=NEW.thread_id;
  END

      l_connections=l_connections-(CASE WHEN OLD.owed_or_over=1 AND OLD.segment='connection' AND OLD.live=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      l_routines=l_routines-(CASE WHEN OLD.kind_segment='routine' AND OLD.live=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      l_to_read=l_to_read-(CASE WHEN OLD.to_read=1 AND (OLD.status<>'digest' OR OLD.read_version IS NULL) AND OLD.live=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      l_results=l_results-(CASE WHEN OLD.decision=0 AND OLD.to_read=0 AND OLD.kind IN ('routine.run','goal.run','text') AND OLD.live=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      o_approvals=o_approvals-(CASE WHEN OLD.decision=1 AND OLD.segment='approval' AND OLD.live=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      o_questions=o_questions-(CASE WHEN OLD.decision=1 AND OLD.segment='question' AND OLD.live=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      o_connections=o_connections-(CASE WHEN OLD.decision=1 AND OLD.segment='connection' AND OLD.live=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      o_decisions=o_decisions-(CASE WHEN OLD.decision=1 AND OLD.live=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),

      owed_open=owed_open-(CASE WHEN OLD.decision=1 AND OLD.expired=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) WHERE thread_id=OLD.thread_id;
    DELETE FROM inbox_counts WHERE thread_id=OLD.thread_id AND v_all<=0;
  END

CREATE TRIGGER inbox_project_insert AFTER INSERT ON messages BEGIN
    DELETE FROM inbox_raw WHERE thread_id=NEW.thread_id AND message_id=NEW.id;
    INSERT INTO inbox_raw(source_row,thread_id,message_id,at,kind,expired,run_id,routine_id,source_key,status,summary,title,kind_segment,terminal,decision) SELECT p.*, CASE WHEN p.status IN ('resolved','completed','failed','cancelled','stopped','missed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN p.status IN ('pending','waiting','needs-input','needs-you') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  FROM (SELECT m.rowid AS source_row, m.thread_id, m.id AS message_id, m.at, m.kind,
    COALESCE(json_extract(m.json,'$.card.expired'),0) AS expired,
    json_extract(m.json,'$.routineRun.runId') AS run_id, json_extract(m.json,'$.routineRun.routineId') AS routine_id,
    json_array(m.thread_id,m.kind,CASE m.kind

      -- they were keyed by message id, so twenty attempts were twenty rows
      -- saying the same sentence. One key per thread per cause makes them one
      -- row carrying the count.

        WHEN json_extract(m.json,'$.tool.authRequired')=1 OR json_extract(m.json,'$.tool.setup')=1 THEN 'connection'

      WHEN json_type(m.json,'$.card.skillRequest')='object' THEN 'Skill proposal'
      -- Question shape wins over the native tool on pending and expired cards.
      WHEN json_extract(m.json,'$.card.expired')=1 THEN
        CASE WHEN (COALESCE(json_extract(m.json,'$.card.folderTrust'),0) IN (0,'')

        WHEN json_extract(m.json,'$.actorKind')='murage' AND json_extract(m.json,'$.murage.kind')='status' AND json_type(m.json,'$.murage.digestDay')='text' THEN 'Daily digest'

    -- The kind column says what SHAPE the message is. This says what it
    -- costs the owner to ignore it, which is the only question the Inbox is
    -- sorted on.

    -- The split inside 'options' is the one the owner asked for: a card

    -- cards carrying a TOOL ask permission for a specific drafted act;
    -- tool-less cards also want a judgement. They
    -- read the same in a list and are nothing alike to answer.
    --
    -- An 'activity' row that is a missing login or an unfinished setup is a
    -- CONNECTION, not provider news: it needs the owner's hands and no
    -- amount of waiting fixes it. A provider simply erroring is news.

  AND (json_type(m.json,'$.card.question')='text' OR json_type(m.json,'$.card.questions')='array')) THEN 'question' WHEN json_type(m.json,'$.card.tool')='text' THEN 'approval' ELSE 'question' END
      WHEN 'secret' THEN 'connection' WHEN 'connector' THEN 'connection' WHEN 'mcpSignIn' THEN 'connection'
      WHEN 'activity' THEN CASE WHEN json_extract(m.json,'$.actorKind')='murage' AND json_extract(m.json,'$.murage.kind')='status' AND json_type(m.json,'$.murage.digestDay')='text' THEN 'result' WHEN json_extract(m.json,'$.tool.authRequired')=1 OR json_extract(m.json,'$.tool.setup')=1 THEN 'connection' ELSE 'routine' END
      WHEN 'routine.run' THEN 'routine' WHEN 'goal.run' THEN 'routine'
      ELSE 'result' END AS kind_segment
    FROM messages m WHERE m.rowid=NEW.rowid AND m.role='bot' AND m.kind IN ('options','secret','connector','mcpSignIn','routine.run','goal.run','activity','text') AND CASE WHEN json_valid(m.json) THEN CASE m.kind
      WHEN 'options' THEN json_type(m.json,'$.card.requestId')='text' OR json_type(m.json,'$.card.routineRequest')='object' OR json_type(m.json,'$.card.skillRequest')='object'
      WHEN 'secret' THEN json_type(m.json,'$.secret')='object'
      WHEN 'connector' THEN json_type(m.json,'$.connector')='object'
      WHEN 'mcpSignIn' THEN json_type(m.json,'$.mcpSignIn')='object'
      WHEN 'routine.run' THEN json_extract(m.json,'$.routineRun.status') NOT IN ('queued','running')

      WHEN 'text' THEN json_type(m.json,'$.artifactIds[0]')='text' AND length(json_extract(m.json,'$.artifactIds[0]'))=36
    END ELSE 0 END) p;
  END

    DELETE FROM inbox_raw WHERE thread_id=OLD.thread_id AND message_id=OLD.id;

    COALESCE(json_extract(m.json,'$.card.expired'),0) AS expired,
    json_extract(m.json,'$.routineRun.runId') AS run_id, json_extract(m.json,'$.routineRun.routineId') AS routine_id,

        WHEN json_extract(m.json,'$.tool.authRequired')=1 OR json_extract(m.json,'$.tool.setup')=1 THEN 'connection'

    CASE m.kind

        WHEN json_extract(m.json,'$.card.orphaned')=1 THEN 'resolved' ELSE 'pending' END
      WHEN 'secret' THEN CASE WHEN json_extract(m.json,'$.secret.provided')=1 OR json_extract(m.json,'$.secret.dismissed')=1 THEN 'resolved' ELSE 'pending' END

      WHEN 'goal.run' THEN json_extract(m.json,'$.goalRun.status') WHEN 'text' THEN 'completed' ELSE 'failed' END AS status,
    -- The projection keeps a PREVIEW (the list shows 280 characters, a digest 1000): capped in SQL so the full text of a huge message is never copied into the projection.

      WHEN json_type(m.json,'$.card.routineRequest')='object' THEN 'Routine proposal'
      WHEN json_type(m.json,'$.card.skillRequest')='object' THEN 'Skill proposal'
      -- Question shape wins over the native tool on pending and expired cards.
      WHEN json_extract(m.json,'$.card.expired')=1 THEN

      WHEN (COALESCE(json_extract(m.json,'$.card.folderTrust'),0) IN (0,'')

      ELSE 'Provider needs attention' END, 1, 2048) AS title,
    -- WHICH OF THE FIVE LISTS THIS BELONGS IN.
    --
    -- The kind column says what SHAPE the message is. This says what it

  AND (json_type(m.json,'$.card.question')='text' OR json_type(m.json,'$.card.questions')='array')) THEN 'question' WHEN json_type(m.json,'$.card.tool')='text' THEN 'approval' ELSE 'question' END
      WHEN 'secret' THEN 'connection' WHEN 'connector' THEN 'connection' WHEN 'mcpSignIn' THEN 'connection'
      WHEN 'activity' THEN CASE WHEN json_extract(m.json,'$.actorKind')='murage' AND json_extract(m.json,'$.murage.kind')='status' AND json_type(m.json,'$.murage.digestDay')='text' THEN 'result' WHEN json_extract(m.json,'$.tool.authRequired')=1 OR json_extract(m.json,'$.tool.setup')=1 THEN 'connection' ELSE 'routine' END
      WHEN 'routine.run' THEN 'routine' WHEN 'goal.run' THEN 'routine'
      ELSE 'result' END AS kind_segment
    FROM messages m WHERE m.rowid=NEW.rowid AND m.role='bot' AND m.kind IN ('options','secret','connector','mcpSignIn','routine.run','goal.run','activity','text') AND CASE WHEN json_valid(m.json) THEN CASE m.kind
      WHEN 'options' THEN json_type(m.json,'$.card.requestId')='text' OR json_type(m.json,'$.card.routineRequest')='object' OR json_type(m.json,'$.card.skillRequest')='object'
      WHEN 'secret' THEN json_type(m.json,'$.secret')='object'
      WHEN 'connector' THEN json_type(m.json,'$.connector')='object'
      WHEN 'mcpSignIn' THEN json_type(m.json,'$.mcpSignIn')='object'

    END ELSE 0 END) p;
